title.narrative: Advancing justice and Women, Peace and Security in Nigeria

description.narrative: Building on our extensive experience in security sector reform and gender-responsive governance, this intervention will consolidate previous efforts while strategically addressing critical gaps in the implementation of key national frameworks. The project will focus on two thematic areas: (i) enhancing the full implementation of the Administration of Criminal Justice Act (ACJA) in Nigeria to promote the protection of citizens’ rights, and (ii) supporting the effective operationalization of the Women, Peace, and Security (WPS) agenda in selected states—Imo, Kaduna, Plateau, Benue, and Nasarawa. The intervention will target law enforcement agencies, women, and youth, strengthening their capacities to uphold human rights and promote inclusive peacebuilding. Activities will include capacity-building workshops, public sensitization campaigns, and the establishment of community-based platforms for monitoring ACJA and WPS implementation. The inclusion of both thematic areas is strategic: while ACJA addresses systemic barriers to justice and accountability, the WPS agenda ensures that women and marginalized groups are meaningfully included in conflict resolution and governance processes. The selected states are conflict-affected areas where strengthening rule of law and promoting gender-inclusive security are crucial for sustainable peace and development. CLEEN Foundation will advocate for the inauguration for and/or strengthen the Administration of Criminal Justice Monitoring Committee (ACJMC) in the focal states as the monitoring and oversight tool.
